scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — Special Beam Cannon (Super)

records.name: Special Beam Cannon (Super)
records.effect: Charges and fires a powerful piercing Special Beam Cannon; this variant is the Super Attack used by Piccolo (Power Awakening).

notes: The canonical identity is kept distinct from Special Beam Cannon as an Ultimate. CaC availability is explicitly false because the documented Super variant is cast-exclusive to Piccolo (Power Awakening).
